title: Strong coloring conjecture for matroid–graph pairs
statement: Let G=(V,E) be a finite graph of maximum degree Δ≥2, and let M be a matroid on V containing 2Δ pairwise disjoint bases. Then M contains 2Δ pairwise disjoint bases, each of which is a stable set of G.

counterexample.description: A simple graph and a prime-field vector matroid whose entire labeled ground set is certified to be a disjoint union of 2Δ bases, but for which exhaustive exact-cover search finds no partition into 2Δ matroid bases that are stable in the graph.
